mapper.select: /* RecipeMapper.selectRecipeInfoList : 레시피 정보 목록 조회 */ SELECT R.RECIPE_ID, R.RECIPE_TTL, R.DISH_NM, R.FILE_GRP_ID, U.USER_NM AS writer_name, R.VIEW_CNT, R.CATEGORY_CD, R.RECIPE_DIFFICULT_CD, R.REG_DT FROM RECIPE R JOIN USERS U ON R.RGTR_KEY = U.USER_KEY WHERE R.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY R.REG_DT DESC

/* RecipeMapper.retrieveRecipeInfo : 레시피 정보 상세 조회 */ SELECT R.RECIPE_SEQ, R.RECIPE_ID, R.RECIPE_TTL, R.DISH_NM, R.RECIPE_CN, R.COOKING_TIME, R.RECIPE_DIFFICULT_CD, R.CATEGORY_CD, R.VIEW_CNT, U.USER_NM AS writer_name, R.REG_DT, R.RECIPE_STATUS, R.FILE_GRP_ID FROM RECIPE R JOIN USERS U ON R.RGTR_KEY = U.USER_KEY WHERE R.RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N'
/* RecipeMapper.selectRecipeIngredientList : 레시피 재료 목록 조회 */ SELECT INGRD_NM, INGRD_AMT, INGRD_UNT FROM INGREDIENT WHERE RECIPE_SEQ = #{recipeSeq} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
/* RecipeMapper.selectRecipeStepList : 레시피 단계 목록 조회 */ SELECT STEP_NO, STEP_CN, FILE_GRP_ID FROM RECIPE_STEP WHERE RECIPE_SEQ = #{recipeSeq} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY STEP_NO
mapper.update: /* RecipeMapper.updateRecipeInfo : 레시피 정보 수정 */ UPDATE RECIPE SET RECIPE_TTL = #{recipeTtl}, DISH_NM = #{dishNm}, RECIPE_CN = #{recipeCn}, COOKING_TIME = #{cookingTime}, RECIPE_DIFFICULT_CD = #{recipeDifficultCd}, CATEGORY_CD = #{categoryCd}, RECIPE_STATUS = #{recipeStatus}, FILE_GRP_ID = #{fileGrpId}, MDFCN_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE RECIPE_SEQ = #{recipeSeq}
